name: Nexeridine
summary: Nexeridine is an opioid analgesic with a similar structure to those of pethidine and tramadol. It was synthesized and assayed in 1975 but was never marketed. The active isomer is (1R,2S)-1-[(2R)-1-(dimethylamino)-2-propanyl]-2-phenylcyclohexyl acetate.

uses.text: It was synthesized and assayed in 1975 but was never marketed.

summaryZh: 奈西利定（英語：nexeridine）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C19H29NO2，結構上與曲馬多和哌替啶類似，可作為類阿片鎮痛藥，1975年首次合成，從未上市銷售。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。

fact.en: Its structure sits between those of pethidine and tramadol. It was made and tested in 1975 but was never sold as a medicine.
fact.zh: 它的結構介於配西汀與曲馬多之間，於 1975 年合成並測試，但從未作為藥物販售。
fact.zhHans: 它的结构介于配西汀与曲马多之间，于 1975 年合成并测试，但从未作为药物贩售。
